description: A support case's state: open, waiting (an answer is on its way), answered (with the answer) or closed; the next step; a dispute's re-drive (queued, running, done). The key of the case's account, or the case_token support_ask gave without a key.

case_id.description: The case's id, from support_ask or dispute_result

case_token.description: Without a key: the token support_ask returned with the case
